global_organization_chain: Summary chain: national scarcity -> five sub-problems -> fitting and GM forecast -> storage and transfer -> desalination and conservation -> integrated evaluation.
Introduction chain: water dependence -> China population/resource imbalance -> three water problems -> demand and efficiency pressure -> strategy horizon.
Notation chain: regional demand and supply -> resources and pressure -> project cost and benefit -> transfer geometry -> desalination and pollution symbols.
Forecast chain: historical data -> fitting alternatives -> fit metrics -> forecast table -> confidence boundary -> grey-model handoff.
Grey chain: data shortage -> factor correlation -> Verhulst suitability -> parameter estimation -> residual test -> 2025 forecast.
Storage chain: time imbalance -> CV -> cost and capacity -> benefit -> province ranking -> future reservoir extensions.
Transfer chain: pressure difference -> province attributes -> route distance -> benefit weight -> terrace and watershed constraints -> local and national routes.
Desalination chain: coastal scarcity -> assumptions -> two-plant cost -> optimal timing -> benefit ratio.
Conservation chain: pollution urgency -> watershed score -> city COD score -> recurrence and cost -> unit-GDP water saving.
Evaluation chain: four strategy benefits -> AHP hierarchy and consistency -> attribute vector -> neural quality class.
Strength chain: objective forecast and indicator quantification -> AHP-neural integration -> acknowledged data and assumption limits.
Government chain: transfer routes and pollution rankings -> inter-watershed action -> within-watershed storage -> public-purpose close.
Appendix chain: named data imports -> regression and fit -> Gray Model -> association coefficients -> diagnostic plots.
The final warning pass records source glyph, data, timing, calibration, and provenance defects without replacing positive language learning.

main_argument_chains.claim: Five complementary models turn China's water imbalance into forecast, project, conservation, and integrated-evaluation decisions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the full model ladder only with typed units, calibrated data, and explicit uncertainty boundaries.

main_argument_chains.claim: Positive model interfaces are reusable when each relation names input, operation, output, and receiving decision.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Transfer the organization and interface, not uncalibrated national numbers.

main_argument_chains.claim: The government paper is strongest when its recommendations trace directly to route, storage, and pollution rankings.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Regenerate leadership prose from a typed result record and reconcile the stated year horizon.
